name: Hendl Paradies
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hendl Paradies in Tirol!**

Discover the heart of Tyrolean hospitality in the charming village of **Tirol**, where every bite of our crispy **Hendl** (roasted chicken) is a taste of tradition. Nestled in the stunning **Zillertal** valley, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our rustic alpine lodge invites you to savor authentic flavors in a cozy mountain setting.

Indulge in our signature **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and dusted with powdered sugar—paired with fresh **Apfelstrudel** and a steaming cup of **Kaffee**. After your meal, warm up by the crackling fireplace with a shot of **Schnaps** or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner**.

Whether you're exploring the nearby **Karwendel** mountains or strolling through **Mayrhofen**’s picturesque streets, **Hendl Paradies** is your home away from home. Come taste the soul of **Tirol**—one delicious bite at a time.
